## Setup required
This workflow is inactive and contains no secrets.

1. Select a Header Auth credential on the Webhook: name `X-RoomPair-Webhook-Secret`, value your secret.
2. Select an HTTP Header Auth credential on OpenAI: name `Authorization`, value `Bearer YOUR_OPENAI_API_KEY`.
3. Review the model in Validate request and your API account access.
4. Publish/activate the workflow. Put its production URL and webhook secret in RoomPair `.env.local`.
5. Run `npm run translate -- lv "Latviešu"` and review the resulting text.

Only UI strings are sent. RoomPair never sends profiles or messages to this workflow.
